subject: DONE s370 (f2c7c25 + 0e5b088): multi-element foreach aliasing — (vector …) at every k + per-element box verdict
description:
SHIPPED in the two commits ruled by docs/fable-answers-s368.md §2c.

STEP 1 f2c7c25 — the wrapper. `Pl::Parser::_foreach_scalar_elements` is the ONE resolver: unwrap via `_foreach_list_unwrap`, split on depth-0 `,`/`=>` with the SHARED #138/#140 splitter (TokenUtils::lowprec_idx / lowprec_split_safe), return the element runs only when EVERY one passes `_foreach_single_scalar_p`. `@el == 1` IS the old single-scalar verdict, so k=1 emission is byte-identical; only k>1 takes the new branch. A depth-0 or/and/xor, an empty slot from a trailing comma, or any non-qualifying element declines the whole list.

STEP 2 0e5b088 — the per-element verdict: the sole-element rewrite run k times, one verdict fn + one head-swapper per pipeline, mapped BY POSITION. Verdicts taken off the UNTOUCHED tokens before any lowering (PExpr's cleanup mutates them destructively). Both lowering sites: Parser2::_lower_compound (tree, _alias_box_form) and the v1 seam in Parser.pm (text, _apply_alias_head, extracted so there is still exactly one text head-swap).

MEASURED (both steps): gate 132/4744 PASS; corpus-diff identical across 111; CPAN board gate SET 0 of 232; perl-suite gate SET 0 of 605; full sweep cold-cache GATE clean 0 new / 0 fixed / 0 LOST, TOTAL 18498->18499. THE SHAPE OCCURS IN NO CORPUS WE OWN — verification is 12 live probes vs perl + Pl/t/foreach-aliasing-01.t 15->20 rows.

RESIDUES (per §2a):
 - MIXED lists (`for ($x, @a)`) still do not alias an aggregate's elements through a box — they keep p-flatten-args with NO boxes. Boxed-aggregates axis, E5, DO-NOT-START.
 - A LITERAL element is writable where perl dies read-only (`for ($x, 3) { $_++ }`). Probed; PRE-EXISTING at N=1 (`for (3) { $_++ }` identical). docs/not-supported.md entry, no mechanism, per §2c.
 - OPEN ASYMMETRY -> ask 2 of docs/opus5-review-requests-s370.md: the failed-anchor path DIES for k>1 but keeps its silent no-op for k=1. Under rule 12 the k=1 path arguably should die too; not changed because it is a live path with a measured population and this commit had no measurement for what would start dying. If ruled, it wants its own commit with both-population gate SETs.
 - VarAnnotator::_ev_foreach_alias_list deliberately keeps its OWN per-slot comma walk (different question: per-slot veto over a list that need NOT qualify, e.g. `for ($x, @a)` must still veto $x's raw slot). Ask 3.
